text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Mejiro Bright—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my~ Look at that~. So many plushies~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Mejiro Bright 
pointed, I saw a claw crane machine filled 
with plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The outfit is so intricately made, it 
looks absolutely darling~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't have the best luck with crane 
games~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When we were little, at an inn the Mejiro 
family visited, Dober and I played it 
together~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I try it, the plushies just seem 
to run away from me~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I doubt she's actively avoiding me, but... 
It wasn't hard to imagine the scene. In 
that case—
choice_data_list: Shall I do it for you instead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Are you suuuure? Then I'll gladly take you 
up on it~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
